mechanistic_claim_tested: Rod R1500P variant shifts heads from SRX/ordered to DRX, raising ATP use and causing hypercontractility/fatigue
key_finding: First R1500P mouse: increased DRX, increased actin-myosin detachment, greater ATP consumption, hypercontractility, fatigue, weakness; MYK-581 rescued running and corrected patient-myofibril DRX
disease_subtype_context: Laing distal myopathy (MPD1), MYH7 rod proline substitution
confidence_limitations: Strong causal/pharmacological evidence but transgenic mouse model; single variant R1500P

mechanistic_claim_tested: LMM variants decrease SRX and raise basal ATP in patients; test whether contractility changes
key_finding: Patient biopsies: decreased SRX, increased basal ATP consumption in vivo, disrupted coiled-coil/filament packing; myofiber contractility NOT affected
confidence_limitations: Supports energetics; refutes human hypercontractility; small heterogeneous cohort, mixed MYH7/MYH2

mechanistic_claim_tested: LMM mutations disrupt thick-filament assembly; protein aggregation as pathology
key_finding: Review: LMM biophysical changes impair thick-filament assembly; subsarcolemmal myosin aggregates in myosin storage myopathy; tubulofilamentous inclusions
disease_subtype_context: MYH7 Laing distal myopathy & myosin storage myopathy

mechanistic_claim_tested: SRX/ATP dysregulation and mavacamten response are variant-specific
key_finding: HCM: thick vs thin filament variants have opposite effects on SRX proportion and ATP; mavacamten responsiveness variant-dependent
confidence_limitations: Cardiac tissue; supports concept that SRX-energetics is variant-specific, cautions against one-size therapy

mechanistic_claim_tested: Biochemical SRX state measurement and IHM/ordered-filament linkage
key_finding: mantATP displacement assay may not cleanly quantify SRX population; SRX/IHM/ordered-filament observations do not always agree (paradoxes)
confidence_limitations: Methodological caution: SRX quantification by mantATP chase (used in seed papers) has assay limitations

mechanistic_claim_tested: Structural basis of SRX via interacting-heads motif (IHM)
key_finding: Cryo-EM: IHM (blocked+free heads) explains relaxation by self-inhibition of ATPases; heads released/disordered on activation

mechanistic_claim_tested: SRX loss + raised resting ATP as pathomechanism in a NON-myosin myopathy gene
key_finding: NEB (nebulin, thin-filament) nemaline myopathy: SRX significantly impaired, increased resting-fiber ATP consumption, metabolic proteome remodeling in nebulin-null mice
confidence_limitations: Shows SRX-energetics is convergent/non-specific to MYH7; strengthens plausibility but weakens specificity

mechanistic_claim_tested: Thick-filament structure modulates myosin SRX nucleotide turnover and thermogenesis
key_finding: Defined SRX (slow ~230s nucleotide turnover); SRX fraction reduced by conditions that disorder thick filament; modulates thermogenesis/whole-body metabolic rate

mechanistic_claim_tested: Myosin SRX/energetics dysregulation in metabolic disease
key_finding: Type 2 diabetes vastus lateralis: GREATER SRX and DECREASED ATP demand (opposite direction), linked to sarcomeric remodeling and myosin glycation
confidence_limitations: Different disease/direction; shows SRX axis is broadly modifiable; raw MS data deposited (PRIDE)

mechanistic_claim_tested: Equivalence of structural OFF/ON and biochemical SRX/DRX transitions
key_finding: dATP moves heads ordered OFF->disordered ON; structural OFF->ON transitions are NOT equivalent to biochemical SRX->DRX transitions
confidence_limitations: Caveat for interpreting X-ray order vs mantATP SRX used in seed papers

mechanistic_claim_tested: Is MYH7 pathology driven by altered-function missense vs haploinsufficiency (premise of SRX model)?
key_finding: gnomAD constraint: pLI~0, LOEUF=0.66 (LoF-tolerant) but mis_z=7.38 (extreme missense intolerance); syn_z=0.69 (null)
confidence_limitations: Computational SUCCEEDED; supports altered-function premise, not direct SRX proof; gene-level not variant/domain-specific

mechanistic_claim_tested: Do rod proline variants act via dominant-negative aggregation rather than energetics?
key_finding: R1500P & L1706P incorporate into sarcomeres but form aggregates sequestering WT myosin; L1706P disrupts antiparallel bare-zone association; aggregates in R1500P nematodes
disease_subtype_context: Laing distal myopathy (MPD1), same R1500P later used in SRX mouse
confidence_limitations: In vitro/non-muscle + C. elegans; dominant-negative mechanism coexists with later SRX phenotype

mechanistic_claim_tested: Clinical/genetic spectrum and genotype-phenotype of MYH7 distal myopathy
key_finding: 88 patients/21 families: footdrop 81%, frequent de novo, variable cardiac (9/21) & spinal (57%) involvement; states mechanisms 'not known'
confidence_limitations: Descriptive cohort; explicit mechanistic knowledge gap, no SRX/energetic measures

mechanistic_claim_tested: Variant-landscape representation of skeletal vs cardiac MYH7 disease
key_finding: ClinVar: 6011 MYH7 records, 1479 P/LP; cardiomyopathy 5070 (~84%) vs skeletal-myopathy ~400-700 (~8-12%)
confidence_limitations: Computational SUCCEEDED; record/text counts not deduplicated; documents cardiac-dominated evidence base
